archive.format: GNU tar with gzip compression; sorted members; zero uid/gid/mtime; empty owner names; regular files 0644; directories 0755; empty gzip filename and zero gzip mtime

recovery.scope: Exact file names, directory names, contents, sizes and SHA256 values are restored and checked. Original ownership and timestamps are not applied; original file mode and mtime are recorded for provenance.

scope: Lossless retention of already collected verification evidence. No Lean execution, source modification, repeated review, branch mutation, PR mutation, or comment.
